title: Bacpac register (layers/INDEX.json bacpacs)
description: The databases published as GitHub Release assets (Foundry #1422, owner ruling vnext-bacpac-artifacts). blank is the database the stock DW10 setup wizard creates at the DW pin; editions.<name> is that database with the edition delivered, exported before any measurement. No entry means the deserialize is the path. Written by the Foundry from the proving runs, never by hand as trusted; tools/ci/Bacpac.ps1 holds the rules a schema cannot state (entry bound to gateProven, tag and asset derived from the entry).

releaseNotes.description: The release-notes record (Foundry #1604, owner ruling distribution-release-notes-1604): the release of this entry ships generated release notes (body and the release-notes.json asset, layers/release-notes.schema.json) as a delta against previousTag. Written by the Foundry from tools/ci/ReleaseNotes.ps1 New-ReleaseNotesRecord when it registers the file. Required on every entry registered after the rule (tools/ci/ReleaseNotes.ps1 Get-ReleaseNotesExemptTag lists the releases published before it).

previousTag.description: The previous release of the same line (the tag this entry replaced in the register); null for the first release of a line.

dwVersion.description: The DW version whose stock setup wizard created the database; equals gateProven.dw.version.

gateRunId.description: The gate run that proved the restored database: an edition delivered onto it and measured PASS.

provedWith.description: Which edition the proof delivered onto the restored database.

gateRunId.description: The gate run on the database restored from THIS file.

deliveryRunId.description: The delivery run that built the database the file was exported from.

provenRunId.description: gateProven.editions.<edition> when the file was built: the run that proved this edition version.

startsFrom.description: The blank bacpac the delivery started from (asset and sha256).
